    Projectives of a successor-closed quotient #

    If P(z) lives on T' (for instance z ∈ B with B successor-closed), the vertex projective of the quotient algebra restricts to P(z) (isoM_res_proj).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.isoM_res_proj {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] {D : DirData k A} {T' : Set D.ι} (hT : D.ConvexSet T') (z : D.ι) (hz : LivesOn T' (projE ⋯)) :
    IsoM (projE ⋯) (resFD (D.qmap T') (projE ⋯))

    The quotient projective at z restricts to P(z).
